text: Evening. Not an emergency I don't think, just want some advice. My stepdaughter is 4 and has had a temp today, 39 when I checked at 10pm. I've given her calpol and she's in bed now. She's otherwise been herself, bit whingy, but that's the constipaton I reckon.
